selection_rule: W-Q's own committed query set (SuperEmbedder_Plan.md sec 4.4b/4.4c: 'drawn from neither the evaluation corpora nor W-B's own documents', 'like W-A, W-Q drives the entry point's edge cases, not its plausible cases'). Two files, two constructions: wq-queries.jsonl is the JOIN LEG, five short strings authored to stress semb_query_encode's own prefix/text join -- a bare single word (no join-adjacent punctuation at all), leading/trailing whitespace (the join separator's own edge), mixed case with digits (a normalisation edge distinct from case-folding), non-ASCII/CJK text crossing UTF-8 multi-byte boundaries (a truncation/byte-counting edge distinct from the truncation-order leg below), and a query whose own text contains the literal special-token string '<|endoftext|>' (stresses whether special-token handling is byte-content-aware or structural). wq-truncation-leg.jsonl is the TRUNCATION-ORDER LEG, one string of 400 distinct numbered tokens (guaranteed distinct from any plausible witness-internal cap the builder's round selects, per SuperEmbedder_Plan.md sec 4.4c: 'a witness-internal cap set below that string's own token count') so composing-then-cutting and cutting-then-composing are forced to disagree by construction whatever cap value is chosen. Neither file's content overlaps tests/fixtures/wb/wb-corpus.jsonl (the shopkeeper-vendor register) or tests/fixtures/c12b/ (the 239-document evaluation corpus) -- confirmed by inspection, distinct register and distinct authored content, D-SLM4090's population-separation principle applied to the query side.
authorship: Authored this round (TE-194), not drawn from any existing corpus.

wq-queries.jsonl.purpose: join leg -- SuperEmbedder_Plan.md sec 4.4c construction 1: 'digests the emitted position for each string under whatever composition the build performs. Catches every composition difference that lives at the prefix/text join: omission, doubling, append-vs-prepend, a join separator, dropped special tokens, caller-text normalisation.'

wq-truncation-leg.jsonl.purpose: truncation-order leg -- SuperEmbedder_Plan.md sec 4.4c construction 2: 'one dedicated longer committed string, at a witness-internal cap set below that string's own token count and independent of any caller-supplied --max-query-tokens... composing-then-cutting and cutting-then-composing are forced to disagree by construction.'

id_scheme: wq-00 through wq-04 for the join leg (decimal, two digits, zero-padded, in this file's own array order); wq-trunc-00 for the single truncation-leg string.
